identity.name: Doral Estates
identity.notes: Doral Estates is an exclusive gated community within the City of Doral, Florida, comprising three residential areas: The Homes of Doral Estates, Doral Colony Townhomes, and The Fairway Villas. The ~71.3-acre community (HOA registered 1979) is set among lakes and the six golf courses of the Doral Country Club, where residents may drive to the club in their own golf carts. It is known for spacious single-family homes, quiet streets, and proximity to Downtown Doral, major expressways, and nearby shopping and fine dining.

fees.note: HOA (Doral Estates Homeowners Association, Inc., est. 1979) resale-certificate disclosures confirm regular periodic assessments are levied, but no specific dollar amount is stated in the directory content; amount fields are left blank in the disclosed template. No management company on file; agent of record is Frank Perez-Siam P.A.

BEX Realty: HOA fees for Doral Estates homes range $498-$848 (varies by home). Includes common area maintenance, grounds, building maintenance, roof repair/replacement, security, property insurance, trash removal, cable TV & internet, parking, recreation facilities. Listing-site figure; confirm via HOA estoppel (mgmt 305-591-8715). No CDD/special assessment data found in public sources. Conflicting range reported separately in next fee fact (per source-conflict rule).

HOA Bulletin Board aggregator: monthly HOA fees typically ~$300-$848 or higher depending on property type and size; exact amounts vary and specific schedules/assessments not in public sources. Aggregator site, lower confidence; do not reconcile with BEX range.

Florida HOA registry: Doral Estates Homeowners Association, Inc. (est. 09/21/1979, Federal ID 592112599, single-family association at 5494 NW 94th Doral Pl, Miami FL 33178) - 'HOA Fee Required' (no dollar amount published). Registry lists property manager as 'DORAL MANAGEMENT COMPANY' (3300 NW 112 Ave Ste 13, Doral FL 33172, 305-591-8715); hoabulletinboard instead names 'Unlimited Property Management' - same address/phone, name discrepancy to confirm.

HOA Bulletin Board lists walking trails, plus 24/7 gated security, lake/golf views, and access to nearby golf facilities for Doral Estates.
BEX Realty: Doral Estates HOA rules allow pets, with a limitation on pet size. Exact breed/size limits not published - obtain full rules from HOA.

Echo Fine Properties: gated entrance with controlled access; no mandatory club or recreational memberships; HOA fees typically cover gate maintenance, common areas, and community management (amount varies).

PGA Tour: the Doral Country Club (founding name of the six-course complex surrounding Doral Estates) was renamed Trump National Doral after 2012 acquisition; residents' cart access to the club is per buyer notes, not confirmed on this page.
